# `⌊` — Floor / Minimum

`⌊Y` rounds down to an exact integer. Pervasive; tolerant near integers. An infinity stays a float.

```apl
⌊1.8 ¯1.8         ⍝ 1ₓ ¯2ₓ
⌊3r2              ⍝ 1ₓ
```

Complex floor uses APL's Gaussian-integer rule.

```apl
⌊1.5j0.5          ⍝ 1j1
```

`X⌊Y` takes the real minimum. Pervasive. Empty reduction identity: `∞`.

```apl
3⌊1 5             ⍝ 1 3
```
